items.title: Consumer confidence slump puts ASX retailers and discretionary stocks in focus
items.summary: Australian consumer-facing stocks are back in focus after confidence fell to a four-year low, raising fresh concerns about discretionary spending heading into the crucial Christmas trading period. The Westpac–Melbourne Institute Consumer Sentiment Index fell 2.7% to 78.2 in November from 80.4...

items.title: Chip stocks' slide nears $5 trillion as Nvidia hits most extreme selling level since 2019
items.summary: Nvidia and memory stocks are dragging chips lower again after a hot inflation report, even as most S&P 500 stocks hold up.

items.title: Qantas sends corporate roles overseas as airline slashes 850 jobs
items.summary: Qantas announces it will slash 850 roles in the coming years, with the first changes expected to be in place by mid-2027.

aus.headline: Consumer Confidence Slumps
aus.body: Westpac's consumer sentiment gauge dropped to 78.2 in November, a four-year low.
aus.why: Weaker confidence puts retail spending in focus ahead of Christmas.

us.headline: Chip Stock Rout Nears $5 Trillion
us.body: Nvidia and memory makers dragged semiconductors down again after hot inflation data.
us.why: Nvidia shares face their heaviest pressure since 2019.

biz.headline: Qantas Cuts 850 Jobs
biz.body: Qantas is moving corporate roles offshore, cutting 850 jobs over the coming years.
biz.why: First changes are slated to take effect by mid-2027.
